{{Quote|Serenno is Imperial-occupied.|[[Hunter]]|<ref name="Spoils of War" />}}
During the early [[Imperial Era]] in the aftermath of the [[Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Empire]] '''occupied'''<ref name="Spoils of War" /> the [[Planet|world]] of<ref name="Serenno DB">{{Databank|serenno|Serenno}}</ref> [[Serenno]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Spoils of War" /> Located deep in the [[Realspace|space]] controlled by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Serenno had been the [[homeworld]] of [[Count]] [[Dooku]],<ref name="Serenno DB" /> the [[Head of State]] of the Confederacy. When the Empire came to the world, it attacked and conquered the former Separatist stronghold, [[Bombardment of Serenno|wiping out]] at least one [[Serenno City|city]].<ref name="Spoils of War" />

With Serenno conquered,<ref name="Spoils of War" /> a [[Wilco's company|company]]<ref name="Ruins AD">{{TBB|Ruins of War}} {{C|[[Disney+]] audio description}}</ref> of [[Clone trooper|clone]] [[stormtrooper]]s under [[Clone Captain]] [[Wilco]] were ordered to pillage the war chest from Dooku's former residence, [[Castle Serenno]]. During the operation, however, the rogue [[Cloning|clones]] of [[Clone Force 99]] arrived on-world to [[Mission to Castle Serenno|steal]] from the war chest,<ref name="Spoils of War" /> encountering the surviving Serennian city resident [[Romar Adell]] after their failure. While Clone Force 99 ultimately escaped, Wilco made note of their appearance in his report on the incident, leading to the [[captain]]'s [[death]] at the hands of [[Vice Admiral]] [[Edmon Rampart]] when Wilco refused to write a falsified report that excluded any mention of the rogue clones. Having informed [[Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] that Clone Force 99 perished during the [[Attack on Kamino|fall]] of [[Tipoca City]], Rampart declared he would write the new report to maintain his standing.<ref name="Ruins of War" />
